tools.name: get_account_summary
tools.description: Read the fictional signed-in customer's current energy plan, estimated monthly cost, and hardship status. No customer identifier is required.

tools.name: apply_hardship
tools.description: Activate the temporary relief program for the fictional signed-in customer under the current Mission Passport.

tools.name: change_plan
tools.description: First request Saver Flex and receive awaiting_approval. After the human approves on the page, call this tool again with approvalId to complete idempotently.
